restraints_config._comment: rgi_utils restraint-guided inference (JAX backend). RUN (partition af3): python run_alphafold.py --run_data_pipeline=False --model_dir=/home/apps/alphafold3/models --json_path=restr_example.json --output_dir=../out_af3_example . MSA is inline (single-sequence) so this is self-contained. NOTE: AF3 rejects unknown JSON keys at the fold-input top level, so usage notes live here inside restraints_config (which AF3 passes through to rgi_utils; '_comment' keys are ignored by the parser). conformer vdw MUST be mode=intramolecular under JAX. The gpu flag is INERT for AF3 (it always runs the jax minimizer on the model's device; to compute on CPU, run the whole process on the JAX CPU platform). AF3's minimizer converges near-target (~24-25 A); the combined distance+conformer uses max_iter=2000. start_sigma: a restraint is active when sigma<=start_sigma; OPTIONAL per distance entry and once in conformer_restraints_config (omit -> active every step); no top-level/global start_sigma. RMSD restraint: rmsd_restraints_config below (REQUIRES a reference PDB — generate it first).

distance_restraints_config._comment: COM distance pulled to target_distance. type: harmonic{target_distance} | flat-bottomed{target_distance1,target_distance2} | flat-bottomed1 | flat-bottomed2. resid = per-chain 1-based ordinal; qualify protein groups with 'chain A and (...)' so a bare resid range does not also match the ligand (chain B). start_sigma is optional on each distance entry (omit -> every step).
distance_restraints_config.atom_selection1: chain A and ((resid 5 to 84) or (resid 186 to 224))
distance_restraints_config._stop_sigma: optional lower bound, default -1 (off); release the restraint below this sigma (window stop<=sigma<=start). Rename '_stop_sigma' -> 'stop_sigma' to enable

conformer_restraints_config._comment: Hold the GLN ligand at its ideal RDKit geometry (bond/angle/chiral; GLN has one stereocentre at CA). dihedral = cis/trans (E/Z) of an acyclic non-aromatic double bond: GLN has none (terminal C=O) so dihedrals=0 here, but all 7 tools detect them when present (e.g. fumarate/maleate). start_sigma applies to ALL conformer terms (one value, all ligands); lower it to enforce ligand geometry only late in denoising. vdw mode=intramolecular is required for the JAX backend.
conformer_restraints_config._stop_sigma: optional lower bound for ALL conformer terms, default -1 (off); release below this sigma. Rename '_stop_sigma' -> 'stop_sigma' to enable

rmsd_restraints_config._comment: RMSD restraint (the gpu flag stays INERT for AF3). Kabsch-superposed RMSD of a moving group toward target_rmsd vs a reference PDB. Generate ref_pdb first: a vanilla AF3 prediction of this sequence converted to PDB (gemmi make_pdb_string). Atoms pair by IDENTITY (chain, resid, atom-name), so the ref atom order need not match. ALL options are shown below; keys starting with '_' are IGNORED by the parser (JSON has no comments, so '_<name>' = a commented-out variable -- rename to '<name>' to enable it).
rmsd_restraints_config._start_sigma: optional, e.g. 99999999; omit -> active every step (1.0 = late only)
rmsd_restraints_config._stop_sigma: optional LOWER bound, default -1 (off). RELEASE the restraint below this sigma (window stop<=sigma<=start) so the model re-idealises geometry it held distorted -- fixes a broken peptide bond at a restrained-residue / free unmodeled-tail boundary; 1.0 validated for this whole-structure target_rmsd=0 case
rmsd_restraints_config._pairing: 'identity' (default: pair by chain/resid/atom-name) | 'align' (HOMOLOG ref: BLOSUM62 sequence-align, tolerates substitutions/indels/renumbering). NOTE align pairs backbone + ANY shared side-chain atom names by default, pinning a substituted residue's side chain onto the ref's coords; add a 'name CA' atom_selection to superpose backbone only
rmsd_restraints_config._best_effort: true (default: skip atoms unmatched in the ref) | false (strict: raise on any unmatched atom)
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_ref: optional; omit -> WHOLE structure. Shorthand ref side (sets BOTH fit & calc), e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)'
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_target: shorthand target side, e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)'
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_ref_fit: OR split: atoms superposed (ref), e.g. 'chain A and (resid 5 to 220)'
rmsd_restraints_config._atom_selection_ref_calc: atoms measured (ref), e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)'
